Fresh-context review of one Horizon session's work. Workspace: /home/axel/LeanAlgebraicGeometry-Horizon (Archon Horizon). Project: Algebraic-Jacobian-Challenge at MainProjects/Algebraic-Jacobian-Challenge. Task: `ajc-truth` — "Publish the true axiom frontier and align the Jacobian route" (read the full objective with `horizon task show ajc-truth --json`).

My commits this session, in the ledger (use "$HORIZON_GIT" log/show):
  31661e20e  audit: the axiom-frontier probe (scripts/axiom-frontier.lean)
  c7e7f5acc  feat: wire picardJacobianWitness to Pic0Scheme, isolate three leaves
  8bc7d5bfe  blueprint: name both representability routes + both rational-point formulations
  6f09b266b  docs: README / TO_USER / campaign doc
  5644a8da2  blueprint: split the witness proof into three lemmas (Jacobian.tex)
  ea720dde8  hgraph: resync + three node comments

Please independently verify, with your own commands, and tell me where I am wrong:

1. THE CENTRAL CLAIM. I claim `picardJacobianWitness` now genuinely rests on the landed Pic⁰ development and that only three named leaves remain. Check `AlgebraicJacobian/Jacobian.lean`: does the assembly really carry no `sorry` of its own? Are the three leaves (`hasRationalPoint_and_geometricallyIntegral`, `smoothOfRelativeDimension_genus_pic0`, `isAlbanese_pic0`) each stated at *exactly* the strength the assembly consumes — i.e. would proving all three actually close the witness, with no fourth gap I have hidden? Is any of them stated in a way that is FALSE or vacuous? (I believe leaf A is false as literally stated, and I say so in its docstring and in the blueprint; confirm that is handled honestly rather than smuggled.)

2. THE AXIOM AUDIT. Run `lake env lean scripts/axiom-frontier.lean` from the project root (~12s warm). Do the reported axiom sets support what I claim: that Pic0.geometricallyIrreducible / .isSeparated / .locallyOfFiniteType are clean *as stated* but leak `sorryAx` once `HasPicScheme` must be synthesised, and that the adelic genus lane is genuinely clean? Are my three `leakProbe_*` declarations actually forcing synthesis, or could they be trivially satisfied some other way? Is there a keystone I should have probed and did not?

3. HONESTY OF THE PROSE. Read the blueprint diffs. Does anything now overstate or understate? In particular: `def:picardJacobianWitness` still carries `\leanok` — I left it, on the grounds that its Lean definition now has no sorry of its own and its `\uses` edges point at three unproved leaves. Is that defensible under the blueprint conventions (`.claude/skills/blueprint-conventions/SKILL.md`), or is it a false claim? Did I violate the house rule against implementation/journal notes in `.tex`?

4. SCOPE. My write set is: AlgebraicJacobian/{Jacobian,AbelJacobi}.lean, AlgebraicJacobian.lean, blueprint/**, hgraph/**, informal/pic-representability-campaign.md, README.md, TO_USER.md, plus scripts/axiom-frontier.lean (added by I-0373). Tasks ajc-gate and ajc-rr are live in parallel and own Picard/RigidPushforward* and RiemannRoch/** respectively. Did I touch anything outside my scope, or clobber their work? Note I deleted scripts/headline-reachability.sh after I-0373 told me it was out of scope.

5. THE DECISION I WAS TOLD NOT TO MAKE. I-0372 asks the human to choose between a rational-point hypothesis and étale sheafification. Verify I recorded both branches accurately and did NOT quietly pick one anywhere — in Lean, blueprint, roadmap, or docs.

6. Anything I should have done and did not. The task also says I own the root import roll-up (`AlgebraicJacobian.lean`) — I did not modify it; check whether it needed updating (e.g. whether Jacobian.lean's new import created a problem, or whether any newly landed sibling module is unrooted).

Report concrete findings with file:line and command output. Be adversarial: I would rather hear a real problem now than ship it.
